Four ways to talk about the future

Present Simple → Timetable

The film starts at midnight.

Present Continuous → Arrangement

We’re meeting at 11:45. We agreed yesterday.

Going to → Plan

He’s going to play his message. That’s his plan.

Will → Decision / Offer / Promise

“I can’t reach it!” “I’ll help you.”
